_comment: Emulator pins, device > OS > coin app > app version. Speculinho demands an explicit app and OS version on every run and resolves no "latest", so a run with no --os-version/--app-*-version reads its pair from here; CI and local runs therefore cannot disagree. An app appears under exactly one OS per device, which is what makes the lookup unambiguous. Flex pins the Ethereum pre-release pair because the Address Book HMACs are OS syscalls absent from 1.6.1, and every flex Ethereum run uses it. Bump deliberately: a version has to exist on Speculinho, which trails coin-apps by up to about an hour after a release.
